finding_key: packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/color-reset.test.ts::color-reset test cannot distinguish `{ color: undefined }` from `{}` — the exact distinction the fix depends on
evidence: Verified: the test (color-reset.test.ts:78-88) asserts via toHaveBeenCalledWith({ color: undefined }), and vitest/jest recursive equality treats an explicitly-undefined key as equal to an absent one, so a call with {} would also pass. The store's clear path (removedInlineStyleAttrs / removedCellStyleAttrs in yorkie-doc-store.ts) keys off `key in style && style[key] === undefined`, so key presence is exactly the property that matters and the test cannot detect its loss. The test still catches the original `""` regression, so the impact is a coverage gap, not a broken test — a minor test-adequacy defect.
